summary: Framework sync must target a repository via --repo, paginate GitHub's path-scoped list endpoints, key commits on sha, and drop pull requests from the issues list without using the filtered page length to decide whether another page exists.
reason: GitHub collaboration resources live under /repos/{owner}/{repo}/... and cannot be enumerated as a flat catalog. The issues list also returns pull requests (pull_request key) whose issue ids must not land in the issues store. Filtering those PRs before the len(page)<100 check makes a full 100-item page look short and stops pagination early. A regen that restores empty defaultSyncResources, disables pagination, stores PRs as issues, or paginates on the filtered slice would make sync a no-op, truncate pages, or duplicate cross-entity data.
validated_outcome: defaultSyncResources is non-empty; resourceSupportsPagination is true for those resources; fillGitHubSyncRepoPath substitutes owner/repo; nvPopulate continues after a 100-item issues page that contains PRs; go test ./internal/cli/... passes.
